ShortDescription.Value: Remembers tool panel settings per savegame (tool mode, snapping, elevation...) with configurable sharing scope. 工具面板设置模式自动记忆

LongDescription.Value:
## **English**
Tired of redoing the same tool options every time you enter a save? **Tool Mode Memory** remembers how you left the tool panel — tool mode, snapping, parallel mode, elevation, underground mode and more — and brings those choices back when you return.
Every savegame gets its own memory file, saved as you work, so a crash does not cost you the options you just set. Leave a save, come back later, and your setup is still there.
**Sharing scope** is configurable per tool item:
* Same group (e.g. all small roads) * Same menu (roads, electricity, ...) * Same asset type (alley, metro track, ...) * Shared globally * Not shared at all
Each item states these five scopes on its own row, with an example that fits that item. Options added by the Anarchy mod can be remembered too, and those rows only do anything when that mod is installed.
Turn the master switch **off** for 100% vanilla behaviour. Memory management (reset memory / manage memory files for all saves / reset all settings), the compatibility switch and the links live on the About tab.
## **中文**
每次进档都要把工具选项重设一遍？**Tool Mode Memory** 会记住你离开时的工具选项——工具模式、对齐、并列模式、高度、地下模式等——下次进入该存档自动恢复。
每个存档单独一份记忆，边玩边实时保存，中途闪退也不会丢掉刚设好的选项。
**共用范围**可按工具项配置：同组 / 同菜单 / 同类资产 / 全局共用 / 全部不共用；每一项的共用范围说明里都按该项自己的例子写清了这五档的含义。
装了 Anarchy 时还能记住它提供的选项，没装时那几项不做任何事。
总开关关闭 = 完全原版行为。重置记忆、管理所有存档的记忆文件、重置所有设置项、兼容性开关与链接都在「关于」页。

PublishConfiguration.ChangeLog:
v0.2.1
* Each option now explains the sharing scopes on its own row, with an example that fits that option (tool mode, elevation, snapping, parallel mode, and so on), instead of one block at the bottom of the page. * Wording was proofread in all 12 languages against the game's own translations. The two Anarchy rows, Left and Right and General, now name the right mod. * The Other row states exactly what it remembers: road colours, brush size and brush strength. * The mod starts enabled: the master switch and the compatibility switch are both on out of the box, and Reset all settings returns to that state.
中文
* 共用范围的五种含义改写在每一个工具项自己的说明里，例子也按该项来举（工具模式、高度、对齐、并列模式等），不再只在页面底部集中写一次。 * 12 种语言的用词重新对照游戏官方译名校对；「左侧和右侧」「常规」两项已标明出自 Anarchy 模组。 * 「其它」一项写清实际记忆内容：道路配色、笔刷粗细、笔刷强度。 * 模组出厂即为开启：总开关与兼容开关默认打开，「重置所有设置项」也会恢复到这一状态。
